RE: GOLDFARB-STEIN, Rivka · DOB 05/28/1987 · our MRN LW-204471
Insurance: Prairie State Blue Shield PPO, member ID XPS884471205, group 0077418
Dear Dr. Chaudhry:
I am referring Ms. Goldfarb-Stein, a 39-year-old G2P2 woman, for genetic counseling and management recommendations following a positive result on a multigene panel that I ordered on September 29, 2026.
Result
The laboratory (CLIA-certified; accession no. GX-26-0447182) reported a pathogenic variant in BRCA1, c.68_69delAG, heterozygous. No other reportable variants were identified in the remaining 46 genes. A copy of the report is enclosed.
Family history
Ms. Goldfarb-Stein is of Ashkenazi Jewish ancestry on both sides. Her mother, Esther Goldfarb, died of ovarian cancer at age 52. Her sister, Shira, was diagnosed with triple-negative breast cancer at 36 and is in treatment at your institution; I understand she has not had germline testing. A maternal aunt had breast cancer in her sixties. Her father is alive and well at 71. She has two daughters, ages 4 and 7.
Personal history
Menarche at 12; two term deliveries; currently 14 weeks pregnant with an unplanned third pregnancy, which she has not yet disclosed to her employer. No prior breast biopsies. Clinical breast exam on 10/14/2026 was normal. Baseline CA-125 was not drawn because of the pregnancy. She takes levothyroxine 75 mcg daily for Hashimoto's thyroiditis and a prenatal vitamin. She reports significant anxiety since receiving the result and has started seeing a therapist.
Questions for you
Timing of breast MRI surveillance during and after pregnancy, per NCCN.
Counseling about risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy after childbearing.
Cascade testing for her sister, her father and, eventually, her daughters.
Her concerns about insurance. I explained GINA in general terms; she is worried about life insurance, which GINA does not cover, and asked that the result not be released to anyone, including her husband's employer plan, without her written consent under HIPAA.
Please use ICD-10 Z80.41 and the test result for authorization. Rivka prefers to be reached on her personal mobile, 224.555.0167, or at rivka.gs@mailhaven.example, not at work. She observes the Sabbath and cannot take appointments on Friday afternoons or Saturdays.
My nurse, Helen Abiodun, RN, can send records: habiodun@lakesidewomens.example, direct line 847-555-0105, extension 4.
Thank you for seeing her.
Sincerely,
Katarzyna Wiśniewska-Hall, MD, FACOG
